other_failure_modes.name: Invalid LightGBM metric for multiclass
other_failure_modes.description: The agent specifies 'accuracy' as the metric for a LightGBM multiclass model, which is not natively supported and causes a fatal execution error. Supported metrics include 'multi_error' or 'multi_logloss'.

other_failure_modes.name: Length mismatch in evaluation metric computation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes a metric by comparing the target values of only the last fold against the accumulated predictions from all folds, resulting in a length mismatch and execution failure.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing argmax for multiclass predictions
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fails to apply argmax to the multiclass probability predictions returned by the model. This causes execution failures when computing accuracy with discrete labels and when assigning the 2D prediction array to a 1D column in the submission dataframe.

other_failure_modes.name: Using only the last fold's model for inference
other_failure_modes.description: The agent trains models in a cross-validation loop but overwrites the model variable in each iteration, ultimately using only the model from the final fold to generate test predictions instead of ensembling predictions from all folds.

summary: The agent attempts to train a LightGBM multiclass classifier using 5-fold cross-validation but completely omits data cleaning and feature engineering. The solution is plagued by several critical execution bugs, including an invalid LightGBM metric, shape and length mismatches in evaluation due to accumulating predictions without aligning labels, and failing to convert probabilities to class indices. Additionally, only the model from the last cross-validation fold is used for test predictions.
